title: Minari: Infrastructure for Collaborative Reinforcement Learning Datasets
abstract: arXiv:2611.18644v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) depends on shared datasets, but sharing them is still hard. Each benchmark ships its own format, documentation is thin, and most datasets cannot be regenerated once the environment code moves on. We introduce Minari, an open-source Python library for creating, sharing, and loading RL datasets. Its API follows Gymnasium, so recording a dataset means wrapping an environment and stepping through it as usual. From there, users can attach metadata, filter, combine, and shuffle datasets, and publish or download them with one command through the HuggingFace Hub. Every dataset stores the environment specification, seeds, applied wrappers, and pinned package requirements needed to rebuild the environment and regenerate the data. TorchRL, AgileRL, and d3rlpy already load Minari datasets natively, so switching datasets in those libraries takes one line of code. Minari also hosts 338 reproducible datasets (350K

translated_title: Minari：协作式强化学习数据集的基础设施
translated_abstract: 离线强化学习（RL）依赖于共享数据集，但共享数据集目前仍然很困难。每个基准测试都使用自己的格式，文档匮乏，而且一旦环境代码演进，大多数数据集就无法重新生成。我们介绍了Minari，一个用于创建、共享和加载强化学习数据集的开源Python库。它的API遵循Gymnasium规范，因此记录数据集只需包装环境并像往常一样逐步交互即可。在此基础上，用户可以附加元数据、过滤、组合和打乱数据集，并通过HuggingFace Hub用一条命令发布或下载数据集。每个数据集都存储了重建环境和重新生成数据所需的环境规范、随机种子、所应用的包装器以及固定的软件包依赖版本。TorchRL、AgileRL和d3rlpy已经原生支持加载Minari数据集，因此在这些库中切换数据集只需一行代码。Minari还托管了338个可重现的数据集（35万个……）
tldr: Minari是一个开源Python库，为离线强化学习提供了标准化、可重现的协作式数据集基础设施，通过兼容Gymnasium的API和HuggingFace Hub集成，实现了数据集的便捷创建、共享和一行代码加载。
en_tdlr: Minari is an open-source Python library that provides standardized, reproducible infrastructure for collaborative offline RL datasets, enabling easy dataset creation, sharing, and one-line loading through its Gymnasium-compatible API and HuggingFace Hub integration.
